ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the intersection's x-coordinate of the lines $y = -x + m$ and $y = nx + 4n$ ($n \neq 0$) is $-2$. What is the solution set of the inequality $-x + m > nx + 4n$ with respect to $x$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} From the graph, it can be seen that when $x < -2$, the graph of the line $y = -x + m$ is above the graph of the line $y = nx + 4n$ (where $n \neq 0$).\\
Therefore, the solution set for the inequality $-x + m > nx + 4n$ with respect to $x$ is $x < -2$.\\
Thus, the answer is: $\boxed{x < -2}$.
